title: PayPal JavaScript SDK v5 is outdated
evidence: The store loads PayPal JavaScript SDK v5; PayPal's current version is v6.

title: PayPal button missing on the cart page
evidence: No PayPal element found on the cart page (desktop, mobile); shoppers only see PayPal at the final checkout step.

title: No PayPal button on the product page
evidence: Shoppers must go to the cart or checkout before PayPal appears.

title: PayPal button hidden below the fold on mobile
evidence: On a mobile screen the shopper must scroll before the PayPal button appears.
